cand.title: Functional RNAs Cell Press Symposium
cand.organizationName: Cell Press Symposia / University of Geneva / Swiss Initiative for RNA & Disease
cand.excerpt: Strong official event evidence and credible scientific/education demand mechanism; venue commitment prevents treating it as open inventory.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Best named operational routing contact: Marie-Claire Morley, publicly named on the 2027 registration page for student-status documentation and on financial support for award applications, m.morley@elsevier.com. Her hotel procurement authority is not stated. Named relationship contacts: Ramesh Pillai, University of Geneva / Swiss Initiative for RNA & Disease, and Krista Bledsoe, Senior scientific editor, Molecular Cell, Cell Press; both are official organizers. Their relevance is a local-partner introduction and Cell Press organizer referral respectively, not verified hotel contract control. No named housing/procurement buyer was established.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced activity: 25–27 October 2027, Geneva, Switzerland, at Fondation Campus Biotech Geneva. These are symposium dates, not publication or abstract-deadline dates, and fall within the requested horizon. The academic partner independently lists the same dates and venue. No later edition was identified in the official material reviewed.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment using the supplied hotel specification: YOTEL Geneva Lake is a 237-room Founex property, not a central-Geneva host hotel. The credible path is conditional satellite lodging, a small organizer/speaker/project group, or a separately requested workshop—not relocation of the committed symposium. Its six meeting rooms and approximately 250-theatre ceiling do not establish suitability for the whole event because 2027 attendance is unpublished. A 20–120-room range is a sales-screening limit supplied in the brief, not event demand. No whole-house, banquet-capacity or resort-retreat claim is justified. Academic city-venue access is a better evidenced requirement than resort amenities; any Founex offer needs an accepted transport plan.
findings.venueCommitments: Published venue commitment: Fondation Campus Biotech Geneva, 9 Chemin des Mines, CH-1202 Genève, Switzerland. Geographic classification: Geneva city, Canton of Geneva; not Founex/Nyon/La Côte or an airport-corridor hotel. The official page states the symposium “will take place” there. This is an announced meeting venue, not evidence of a signed contract or accommodation commitment. It is not a competing hotel. The venue page describes arrival from Geneva Airport via Cornavin and onward public transport; no delegate lodging toward La Côte is published. Not a Lausanne or French-border activity.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified same-title edition: 20–22 October 2024, Beijing, Four Points by Sheraton Beijing, Haidian Hotel; next verified same-title edition: Geneva, 25–27 October 2027, Fondation Campus Biotech Geneva. Related Regulatory RNAs meetings appear in the Cell archive: 12–14 May 2019, Berlin, Langenbeck Virchow Haus; 19–21 October 2014, Berkeley, Claremont Hotel. Treat these two as related-theme meetings, not proven numbered editions of Functional RNAs. Beijing-to-Geneva demonstrates a destination change, not a fixed rotation or annual/triennial recurrence commitment.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 hotel sourcing is unconfirmed. The edition-specific accommodation page says “More information coming soon...” and names no hotels, rates, room blocks, room quantities, housing bureau or open RFP. Its warning says: “All accommodation bookings should be made directly through the conference hotel(s), using the accommodation booking link on the website where specified.” This generic direction does not establish that a hotel has been appointed. EHS, EHM and BTM are named in a scam warning, not as authorized suppliers. Historical 2024 evidence is different: “Accommodation has been reserved for delegates at specially negotiated rates” at Four Points by Sheraton Beijing, Haidian Hotel and Aloft Beijing, Haidian, with rates valid until 20 September 2024. Those are historical arrangements only, not 2027 incumbents.
findings.organizationStructure: Publisher-led scientific symposium: the event is branded Cell Press Symposia, in partnership with the University of Geneva and Swiss Initiative for RNA & Disease. Official financial-support text names “Cell Press and the Elsevier Conferences team”; registration and support operate through Elsevier channels. Classify as publisher/corporate conference operation with academic partners, not a verified association-owned congress. Campus Biotech is the venue; the university and Swiss initiative are partners. No external PCO/DMC or housing agent is identified. The legal contracting entity and accommodation decision-maker remain unverified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The committed Geneva-city venue and published airport-to-Cornavin-to-campus access favor convenient city lodging as a commercial inference. No named 2027 competing hotel, sell-out, unmet demand, displacement or overflow requirement is published. The 2024 Four Points/Aloft reserved-rate arrangements show that this event has previously organized specific hotel accommodation, but do not prove the 2027 lodging model. No 2027 attendance, peak rooms or room-night figure was found; do not transplant the more-than-330 attendance reported for the differently titled 2014 Berkeley meeting.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Marie-Claire Morley at m.morley@elsevier.com, clearly as a hotel supplier seeking referral to the 2027 accommodation/logistics lead; alternatively use the official conferences@elsevier.com channel. Ask whether hotels or room allocations are already contracted, whether an additional Founex option can be considered, the required nights/rooms/budget and transport expectations. Seek a local introduction through Ramesh Pillai; use Krista Bledsoe only for organizer routing. Do not send an unsolicited block proposal or claim official-hotel status. Proceed to a modest satellite offer only after permission and transport feasibility are confirmed; otherwise retain a future-cycle relationship lead.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the currently announced 2027 edition, meeting-venue capture is not supported because Campus Biotech is announced. Lodging accessibility remains unknown—not open and not proven committed elsewhere. Pursue only a qualification conversation about whether independent or supplementary lodging is allowed, which hotels are appointed and who manages allocations. No verified overflow opportunity exists.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Relationship-led potential only. The 2024 Beijing and 2027 Geneva editions establish repeat use of the Functional RNAs title and changing destinations, not annual recurrence or a subsequent Swiss edition. For any later cycle, offer Founex only if destination, scale, transport and food-service requirements fit; an ancillary workshop or selective lodging group is more defensible than claiming the main symposium. No post-2027 date or venue is established.
